note: NISR EICV7 2023-24 (cross-sectional sample), household-weighted, 95% design-based intervals (strata + clusters). Out-of-fold model scores; 200 cluster-bootstrap replicates, seed 42. Budget = share of all households supported. Cost is in units of the cost of supporting one household (=1).
rule_A_note: Rule A has exactly 1 record per area, at that area's observed actual_coverage; B and C cover budgets 1% to 50%.
share_scale_note: poor_reached, poor_reached_ci and extreme_poor_reached are fractions in [0,1] of the area's poor (or extreme-poor) households, not counts.

scorecard.note: Points are rounded logistic coefficients (largest = 10); a household's score is the sum of its points.
